messages:
Jamie: quick heads-up — MeridianFin's product analytics org just told me they plan to roll out a personalized insights feed to 6 internal squads starting mid-May. asked for expected qps numbers and they said this is likely high-throughput.
Ravi: do we know workload shape? sync vs streaming?
Jamie: mostly async batch scoring + some interactive queries. they called out spikes during EOD and month-end reporting. estimated steady 120 rps, peaks to ~450 rps for short windows.
Elena: renewal for MeridianFin is end of Q3 — this could be a material expansion if enabled, or a risk if they stall. we should prioritize an enablement plan.
Monica: can we run a quick perf/cost estimate for 120 rps steady + 450 rps peaks? also want to know memory/kv cache implications for their 8k token context use case.
Ravi: yep — initial ask: model = r-instruct-3b (their current). rough calc: 120 rps * avg 1.5k toks = ~180k toks/sec => that's big. need to check batching gains and whether prefix cache helps.
Ravi: pinging @traffic-bot for a synthetic canary run?
traffic-bot: scheduled synthetic load job for thread 1837654321 -> job id: tf-98721, will run a 10m profile at 150/450 rps buckets and upload results to /shared/meridianfin/profiles/.
Jamie: perfect. Monica/Elena — let's book a 30m enablement with their engineering lead next Tue to walk throughput patterns + propose options (hosted + burst or dedicated pilot).
Elena: adding agenda: 1) traffic patterns 2) cost estimates 3) rollout plan + canary steps 4) success criteria for expansion. I'll include renewal owners.
Monica: for cost estimates, Ravi — can you surface two configs: (A) hosted with autoscale + KV caching, (B) 1-week dedicated pilot w/ reserved GPUs. include rough monthly $ and ops overhead.
Ravi: on it. will attach sample curl + load command we used for the canary: ```
# example artillery snippet
config:
  target: https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  phases:
    - duration: 600
      arrivalRate: 150
scenarios:
  - flow:
    - post:
        url: "/chat"
        json: {"model":"r-instruct-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize transaction logs"}]} 
```
Jamie: also capture enablement docs & checklist for their internal platform team — onboarding friction was the main blocker last quarter.
Elena: i'll loop in SRE and AE for contract language if we propose pilot credits.
Monica: flagged as priority: "meridianfin-analytics-throughput" in our tracker. assigned follow-ups after canary.
Jamie: thanks all. if the canary looks good, this is a strong expansion signal — could move them from self-serve to sales-assisted onboarding. :rocket:
